short_description:
Vice Replay Tier List #2: every 3D-era GTA ranked by its last reported sales. B: GTA III (14.5 million) and Vice City (17.5 million), both as of March 2008 (Take-Two). A: GTA IV (25 million+) and San Andreas (27.5 million). S, alone: GTA V, over 230 million (Take-Two). GTA 6 is too new for a unit count: Take-Two has only reported $3.79 billion in pre-orders plus day one. Where will it land?

Sources: Take-Two, PC Gamer, Statista, Wikipedia, Sportskeeda, Twinfinite.
